name: Lens2Go Video Generator
author: sclynch

sections.description:
Lens2Go Video Generator automatically creates stunning property videos from your listing photos. Perfect for real estate agents who want to enhance their listings with professional video content.

Key Features:

  • One-click video generation from property photos
  • Professional cinematic camera movements
  • Automatic photo detection from galleries
  • Video URL for sharing to realestate.com.au
  • Optional video player embedding on your listings
  • Works with any WordPress theme

How It Works:

  1. Upload your property photos as normal
  2. Click “Generate Lens2Go Video” in the post editor
  3. A professional property video is created automatically
  4. The video is auto-embedded in your listing – nothing else to do
  5. Optionally copy the video URL for use on portals like realestate.com.au

Requirements:

  • Lens2Go account with API key (included automatically when you download the plugin)
  • Credits for video generation (1 credit per video, 3 free credits to start)

Getting Your API Key

When you download this plugin from Lens2Go, your API key is provided automatically:

  1. Log in to app.lens2go.com.au
  2. Click “Resources” in the sidebar
  3. Click “Get Plugin & API Key” on the WordPress Plugin card
  4. Your API key will be displayed and the plugin will download automatically
  5. Copy the API key and paste it into Settings > Lens2Go in WordPress

You’ll receive 3 free credits to try out the video generation. Each video uses 1 credit.

To purchase more credits or manage your account, click “Open Portal Dashboard” on the WordPress Access page, or visit your portal link saved in your browser bookmarks.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Lens2Go video generation service at https://app.lens2go.com.au to generate professional property videos from your listing photos.

What data is sent and when

  • On plugin activation and when saving your API key: Your website URL and admin email address are sent to register your site with the Lens2Go service.
  • When testing the connection or checking credits: Your API key is sent to verify your account and retrieve your credit balance.
  • When generating a video: Your property photo URLs, listing title, post ID, and website URL are sent to create the video.
  • When checking video status: The job ID is sent to check the progress of your video generation.

No data is sent without user action (clicking a button or saving settings). No visitor data is ever collected or transmitted.

Service links

  • Service provider: Lens2Go Pty Ltd
  • Website: https://lens2go.com.au
  • Privacy Policy: https://lens2go.com.au/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Service: https://lens2go.com.au/terms-of-service/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the lens2go folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Lens2Go to enter your API key
  4. Start generating videos from your listings!
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API key?

Your API key is provided when you download the plugin from app.lens2go.com.au. Go to Resources > WordPress Plugin > Get Plugin & API Key. You’ll see your API key with a copy button.

How much does it cost?

You get 3 free credits when you first sign up. Each video generation uses 1 credit. You can purchase more credits through your portal dashboard.

What image formats are supported?

JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP images are supported.

Can I use the video on realestate.com.au?

Yes! You can copy the video URL and submit it to realestate.com.au. The video is also automatically embedded in your WordPress listing – just check your listing page.

How do I buy more credits?

Click “Open Portal Dashboard” on the WordPress Access page at app.lens2go.com.au, or use the portal link you bookmarked. From there you can view your balance and purchase more credits.
